facts.fact: MP Maha Abdel Nasser says she filed a 24-article freedom of information bill, prepared with the Journalists Syndicate, in the House of Representatives in the last week of its first session, and the explanatory memorandum says the legislation Article 68 of the constitution calls for is still absent.
facts.system: Freedom of Information Bill (Abdel Nasser / Journalists Syndicate)
